crossRefs.note: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…
but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
translations.bsb: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
translations.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
translations.asv: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Psalm 132 A Song of Ascents.
